title: XAUUSD: H4 impulse -> H4 pullback -> M15 micro-break confirmation -> next move
data_access_statement: Written in a cloud container that has no copy of the Phase 7 tick files and cannot reach Dukascopy. No outcome, event count or price of this family has been computed on any period before this file was committed.
question: After a directional H4 impulse and a pullback of at least 38.2% of the leg, does an M15 micro-break in the impulse direction reach +2R before -1R more often than the same M15 rule without the H4 context, net of the bid/ask spread?
primary_outcome: p_target_first: share of closed trades that touch +target_r R before the stop, entries on the fill side (long on ask, short on bid), exits on the opposite side
comparator: CONTROL rows: same M15 confirmation, stop and outcome rule applied at every other H4 close of the split, both directions, without impulse or pullback. Descriptive comparator, not the matched baseline of phase7/engine/baseline_engine_v4.py (that integration is a later step).

param_provenance.impulse_body_atr_mult: 1.5 = DISPLACEMENT threshold of phase5/build_events.py CFG, but measured on ATR of the previous bar (causal) instead of ATR including the bar itself
param_provenance.pullback_retrace_min: 0.382 Fibonacci retracement, chosen a priori, not fitted
param_provenance.target_r: 2.0 chosen a priori; MFE quantiles are reported so other targets can be read descriptively, never re-selected on validation
param_provenance.commission_r: 0: Dukascopy spread only. Broker commission is not modelled; results are an upper bound for a commission account

internal_validation.warmup_source: last 31 days of discovery, lookback only
internal_validation.access: LIMITED, max 3 reads per candidate, recorded in the persistent ledger by run_experiment.py

locked_validation.access: NOT AVAILABLE to run_experiment.py V1 (refused). One-shot, only after a PRE_REGISTERED_CANDIDATE verdict on internal_validation.

exposure_statement.this_hypothesis: No period has been read for this hypothesis.
exposure_statement.neighbouring_studies: MT5 studies of BREAKOUT_ACC (2019-02..2026-09), ORDER_BLOCK (2023-10..2026-09) and LIQ_SWEEP (2023-10..2026-09) looked at signals and P&L across locked_validation and final_holdout (phase7_26/data_exposure_registry_v1.json). An H4 impulse is close to the breakout/displacement family, so neither window is a fully independent holdout for this hypothesis.
exposure_statement.consequence: A positive result here can at most reach PRE_REGISTERED_CANDIDATE after internal_validation. Independence must then come from data after 2026-09-17 (forward collection), not from re-reading 2025-2026.
exposure_statement.rule: Parameters may change only under a new hypothesis_id. run_experiment.py refuses a run whose params hash differs from an earlier run of the same hypothesis_id.

censoring: Outcomes never read bars ending after the split end; trades that need them are CENSORED and excluded from the primary outcome.
known_limits: BID-based levels from Dukascopy, not the XM broker feed; MT5 parity is a later step
Same-bar target and stop: the stop is counted first (conservative)
Stop fills at the stop price: no slippage modelled
Overlapping events (impulses close in time) are not independent; month-block bootstrap is descriptive, dependence diagnostics of phase7/engine come later
